assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target image 1: EXACT original transparent 2D game sprite Impactus. Keep the original illustration, face, eyes, expression, white/violet body armor, limbs, stance, camera, proportions and 768x768 registration unchanged. The character must remain this exact 2D illustration. Dress ONLY with a snug urban gardener hat and backpack. Replace purple cape with a small sage-green portable plant nursery backpack WORN ON THE BACK, aligned to torso behind shoulders. We see the robot from FRONT three-quarter view: show only a narrow SIDE PROFILE of the backpack behind its screen-right shoulder and arm, NOT its big rear-facing window presented toward the camera, no separate floating object. The pack's shoulder straps pass over the shoulders and curve flush along the ribs, disappear under arms; its top sits below the neck. Three seedling leaves and a side turquoise reservoir subtly emerge from behind shoulder. Add a low-crown woven pale straw sunhat fitted AROUND the actual upper helmet, correct elliptical opening and head angle: rear brim hidden behind the helmet, front brim slopes around forehead, crown wraps the upper helmet. Hide the purple head crest where the hat covers it. The hat's front opening makes believable direct contact with forehead, warm ambient-occlusion shadow ON the helmet beneath brim. The hat is not hovering or placed above the skull. Same high-quality illustrated highlights and soft light as original robot. Preserve recognizable purple headphones. No jacket. No typography, no scene, no ground plane or shadow; true transparent alpha. This is a finished wearable composition, not separate products next to a character. Preserve original feet and hands positions exactly. All accessories compact and plausible for sustainable city gardening.

Precise 2D wardrobe illustration. Reference 1 is the EXACT original Impactus sprite. Reference 2 demonstrates correct worn backpack perspective and straps; do NOT copy its checkerboard. Preserve the robot identity, original body, expression, stance, 3/4 view and pixel registration of reference 1. Keep its white and purple armor and cyan wink. Render original character wearing a compact SOLAR CITY TECHNICIAN set, replacing only the cape: (1) a close-fitting glossy amber-yellow bicycle/safety helmet hugging the upper white head shell, with ivory edge, subtle integrated thin deep-blue solar-cell strip on top, head-shaped opening, contact shadow on the actual forehead; hide covered parts of the purple crest. Leave face and headphones free. No brim or floating helmet. (2) a SMALL dark violet solar charger backpack worn tightly on the BACK, only a narrow side-profile visible behind screen-right shoulder and upper arm. A slim fold-out blue solar panel is vertical and close to the pack at the rear, not giant wings. Orange shoulder straps flow continuously over shoulders down the chest edges, curve around ribs, and disappear under arms into the SAME backpack. Low-key small cyan energy indicator and copper fasteners. No jacket; white lightning chest plate stays. Front three-quarter perspective: do NOT show the backpack rear panel facing the viewer. Original robot pose and proportions should be exactly retained; no character redesign. Stylish premium 2D rendered game illustration with original soft gloss, believable illustrated materials and light, contact at every attachment. Full body within square canvas. No text, no ground or shadow. REAL transparent RGBA backdrop, do not draw any checkerboard.

Precise 2D wardrobe illustration. Image 1 is original Impactus and image 2 is fitted gardening gear reference. Make a circular-economy workshop look worn on image 1, preserving original sprite identity, exact camera, pose, scale, body, cyan wink, face, hands, feet and white/violet armor. No character redesign. Replace ONLY cape with a slim upcycled denim and warm tan canvas TOOL BACKPACK on the back, in correct front-three-quarter perspective: only its narrow side behind screen-right shoulder/arm is visible, tools tucked vertically in side pockets, small orange roll at top below neck, straps wrap OVER shoulders down chest edges and under arms connecting to same pack. No big rear panel facing camera, no floating toolbox. No jacket. On head add gorgeous practical circular safety goggles with two small honey-amber brass frames and clear turquoise lenses resting snugly ABOVE the face on the curved white forehead, wide brown elastic strap curving around the helmet and behind ear pieces; its arc follows the round skull. Goggles are worn on forehead, not covering cyan eyes. Purple crest stays in the middle/behind the goggle band, so the right/left lenses follow forehead volume at slightly different angle and size. Head and arms unchanged. Subtle contact shadows directly under strap and goggles; no floating eyewear. Same polished original illustrated lighting, soft gloss, grounded sustainable repair-worker theme, no magic. Full body, true transparent alpha, no ground shadow or backdrop. Do not draw checkerboard.

2D GAME SPRITE LAYER EXTRACTION, not catalogue product photography. The three reference images show the SAME robot wearing backpacks, in a FRONT THREE-QUARTER view. Produce a single sprite sheet with exactly THREE isolated backpack REAR LAYERS arranged in one horizontal row, left solar, center gardening, right repair. Remove ALL robots, helmets, bodies, hands and foreground shoulder straps. Extract the backpacks in EXACTLY their worn viewing direction from these references and complete the small parts previously occluded by the robot's right arm and torso using the matching material. Their silhouettes are tall and NARROW: mostly a SIDE WALL, NOT the broad back panel. Do not rotate to show the broad decorated rear face. Each has its attachment/front surface toward viewer's LEFT, thin top plane, outer SIDE profile toward viewer's RIGHT. Left: narrow dark violet solar charger case with one blue-cell solar panel mounted flush on its visible right side, orange hardware, tiny cyan energy status. Center: narrow sage green fabric plant nursery pack, little leaves above, turquoise side water bottle in green elastic pocket on the visible right side, plain dark green fabric along its inner-left edge. Right: narrow blue denim tan-trimmed tool pack, rolled orange fabric at top, wrench/screwdriver in visible right-side pockets, tan inner edge. All approximately same height, objects separated by generous gaps. Keep matching reference illustrations, soft glossy game art lighting, precisely the existing palette, and no extra ornaments, no character parts or generic extra long straps. True transparent background. Each is a layer to be placed BEHIND the original robot with separate foreground shoulder straps. Maintain convincing worn view and narrow thickness: max width about 40% of height. No white shape, checkerboard, text, floor, shadows or labels.
